subject: P5-MS3: event-only usage + adapter-triggered reconcile
description:
Hot path: event-only (agent/done). Cold path: per-harness reconcile — never on /costflow. Two adapter-owned triggers (no daemon global cron).

Uniform UsageSlice:
  { harness, agent_id, session_id, transcript_path, task_key?, startedAt, endedAt, usage, human, overhead }

Adapter contract:
  - usage.sample(transcript_path, { baseline?, window }) → UsageSlice  (single file, agent/done)
  - usage.normalizeReported(raw) → UsageSlice
  - usage.reconcile(workspace, { since }) → UsageReport  (adapter sweeps its own dirs, normalizes to our shape)
  - usage.onSessionStart({ session, workspace }) → optional: arm adapter scheduler for long-running IDE sessions (see below)

Hot path (/agent/done): sample one file → overlay.usage_records[agent_id]; link task_key; complete_task sums only.

Cold path — TWO triggers per harness (standing timestamp in overlay.usage_reconcile[harness].at):
  1. sessionStart (IDE opens): POST /workspace or POST /usage/reconcile { harness, workspace, session }. Daemon checks overlay.usage_reconcile[harness].at — if missing or >24h (configurable), run that adapter.reconcile() once, update at + merge usage_reconcile_snapshot. IDE-not-open ⇒ no sweep for that harness (correct).
  2. Adapter scheduler (IDE left on overnight): on sessionStart each adapter arms its own daily re-check via existing scheduler substrate — Cursor/Codex: schedule-wakeup.sh / MCP ScheduleWakeup; Claude: native ScheduleWakeup; OpenCode: schedule_wakeup plugin. Fire target is mechanical: hook script or minimal prompt curls POST /usage/reconcile { harness } (same stale-at gate — skip if already fresh). Cancel/reschedule on next sessionStart (cancel prior wake, arm new 24h). No daemon setInterval.

/costflow: sum usage_records + last reconcile snapshot. Never readdir on GET.

Move daemon.readUsage to Claude adapter. Delete per-request sweeps from routes/analytics.js.

Acceptance: agent/done updates totals; sessionStart stale-harness reconciles once; long session daily re-check via adapter scheduler; grep /costflow handler has no listSessionTranscripts.
